title: Letter Visitors
lede: Letter Visitors names the people, companies and AI agents browsing a website, overlays that information on the site itself, and records sessions so they can be replayed.

points: Identifies individual visitors and the companies they belong to, rather than only counting sessions and referrers.
Flags AI agents that read your pages, listed alongside human visitors.
Shows visitor details as a layer on your own site, so there is no separate analytics dashboard to switch to.
Session replay shows how each visitor moved through a page and what they interacted with.
Early commenters ask about WordPress support, GDPR compliance, VPN traffic and how it compares with Clarity and PostHog.

sections.text: Growth and marketing teams who already bring in traffic through SEO and campaigns, and want to know which people and companies are showing interest, a question the launch comment says Google Analytics leaves open.
